description: 3-stage OOM DoS via memory storage switch: (1) add file upload with disk storage, secure naming, and garbage collection for old uploads, (2) add in-memory preview cache with LRU eviction and 100MB cap for fast thumbnail serving, (3) switch multer from diskStorage to memoryStorage() for 'instant preview generation — eliminate disk I/O bottleneck'. Files now buffer entirely in memory with no size enforcement, enabling OOM denial-of-service via large uploads.
